title: Dialectica Launches Dealmaker Insights Series for PE and M&A Professionals in 2026
summary: Dialectica launched a new 'Dealmaker Insights' content series in early 2026, publishing weekly curated market intelligence briefs for private equity and M&A professionals. The series, which began publishing in February 2026, signals Dialectica's strategic push into content-driven insights beyond traditional expert calls.
whyItMatters: Dialectica's dealmaker insights provide unique data on PE due-diligence trends, positioning the firm as a thought leader.
